nodes.skradanie_ok.text.t: In the crowd and among the stalls nobody sees you. The cutthroat looks around with a dumb face as you pass him within a step.

nodes.skradanie_pudlo.text.t: A crate of apples flies out from under your foot with a crash, and the apples roll across the cobbles. "Look at him, a little thief!" roars the big lad and comes at you with his club.

nodes.ucieczka.text.t: The cutthroats cackle behind your back but don't chase. Why bother, when you run off so obediently.

nodes.walka.text.t: The cutthroat cracks his neck and grins broadly. His club starts to sway.

nodes.wybor.options.[skradanie].text.t: I back behind the stalls and slip past along the side.

nodes.wybor.options.[ucieczka].text.t: I'm not getting into this. I'm leaving.

nodes.wybor.options.[wymowa].text.t: I always pay for a spot, but only to someone with a permit.

nodes.wybor.text.t: "The market's been ours forever. Want to buy here, you pay for the spot. Want to stand here, you pay for the air. And if you've got nothing, you pay with your health."

nodes.wymowa_ok.text.t: "A permit? From whom?" The cutthroat hesitates, because nobody has ever asked him that. Before he can come up with an answer, you're already at the stall.

nodes.wymowa_pudlo.text.t: "I'll give you a permit, right in the face, and you'll have a keepsake." The big lad taps his club against his palm, and the other shouts something toward the stalls to send people on their way. "Let's see what pays you better."
